decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024 suggests improving traction in the firm's core safety-footwear business, so the option value of continuing remains high.
This insole stayed only at mention-level and faces overlap with other insole options, but because it is inexpensive to keep and uncertainty is not fully resolved, it is still worth retaining for now.

With no increase in prominence from 2023 to 2024 and strong internal competition from other insole products, especially the better-signaled custom option, this looks like a weak option to continue carrying.
Having its own page in both years indicates an early and sustained commitment to a core product family, making abandonment in the next year unlikely.
The step up from a mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 signals positive information about demand in a specialized professional segment, so the firm would likely continue it.
Its home-page visibility in both years and the specific reference to customer use and individualized fitting indicate clear market validation, so keeping it is the most likely choice.
